target.runtimeDependencyPolicy: OpenSSL 1.0/1.1 and a compatible ICU remain external dependencies. Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 and Debian 13 passed with the recorded Focal OpenSSL 1.1 bundle. Stock OpenSSL 3 only or ICU 76 only compatibility is not claimed.

patches.name: 0001-forward-coreclr-native-arm64-sysroot.patch
patches.purpose: Forward the independent target sysroot to CoreCLR on native ARM64; omit only redundant cross-architecture host tools.

patches.name: 0002-forward-corefx-native-arm64-sysroot.patch
patches.purpose: Forward explicit cross and LLVM9 arguments through the existing CoreFX native compiler pass-through.

patches.name: 0003-forward-core-setup-native-arm64-sysroot.patch
patches.purpose: Select the target sysroot for native hosts without disabling CoreSetup native image generation.

patches.name: 0004-run-native-arm64-corelib-crossgen.patch
patches.purpose: Run native ARM64 crossgen during same-architecture sysroot builds rather than copying the IL-only CoreLib. Package the actual native tools without assuming separate cross-architecture host outputs.

patches.name: 0005-preserve-explicit-source-acquisition-command.patch
patches.purpose: Preserve an explicit source-acquisition executable instead of overwriting it with the unavailable historical Darc DLL during target execution.

patches.name: 0006-route-retired-dotnet-core-feed.patch
patches.purpose: Route only the retired dotnet-core service indices to the official public package mirror while preserving all requested versions and local source-built precedence.

patches.name: 0007-expand-recorded-retired-package-index-mapping.patch
patches.purpose: Extend the original common feed-mapping producer to all five recorded retired package indexes, preserving exact requested versions, local source-built precedence and blob asset URLs. Apply only after the byte-exact original patch0006 state.

patches.name: 0008-forward-corefx-cross-mode-with-singleword-properties.patch
patches.purpose: Pass compiler selection and explicit cross mode as separate singleword MSBuild properties through the historical Arcade shell driver.

patches.name: 0009-forward-corefx-native-cross-build-property.patch
patches.purpose: Forward explicit CrossBuild to the existing native cross switch so the independent target sysroot is retained without a multiword compiler property.

patches.name: 0010-complete-corefx-cross-tryrun-cache.patch
patches.purpose: Supply empty captured output for the three silent cross feature probes whose exit statuses are already specified upstream, retaining all existing feature decisions and compile/link checks.

patches.name: 0011-preserve-explicit-bootstrap-http-handler.patch
patches.purpose: Honor an explicit supported bootstrap HTTP handler instead of unconditionally forcing the obsolete CurlHandler; retain the historical workaround only as the standalone default.
